control_device_fabrication: The device exhibited a PCE of 25.147%, with VOC of 1.17917 V, FF of 81.2593%, and JSC of 26.2444 mA/cm². 1.65 mol/L Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85I3 perovskite precursors were prepared. SAM material 4,4,4-NA (0.5 mg/mL) was added to influence crystal growth at the interface and optimize surface passivation. To enhance device performance, MACl (15.0 mg/mL) and m-Br-PEACl (2.0 mg/mL) were added to the perovskite solution as additives. For the perovskite films, the spin-coated process was divided by a consecutive two-step process, the spin rate of the first step is 1000 rpm for 5 s, and the spin rate of the second step is 5500 rpm for 30 s. At the 15 s of spinning, 150 µL of anti-solvent CB was dripped at the center. Subsequently, the sample was annealed at 110 °C for 15 min. The passivation solution was prepared using PDADI (0.5 mg/mL). Spin-coating of the passivation layer was performed at 5000 rpm for 30 s. During the spin-coating of the passivation layer, 70 µL of passivator was added at 6 s. The passivation layer was then annealed at 100 °C for 5 min to enhance film quality. In details, SAM solution was spin-coated on the substrate at 3000 rpm for 30 s, and annealed at 100 °C for 10 min.
target_device_fabrication: The PCE of the device was increased to 26.2531% with an FF of 82.9223%, VOC of 1.19423 V and JSC of 26.5107 mA/cm². The perovskite precursor solution was prepared based on the perovskite composition of Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85I3 in anhydrous DMF solvent (total concentration of 1.65 mol/L). A SAM solution consisting of 4,4,4-NA (0.5 mg/mL) in ethanol was prepared. For the additives treated cells, the MACl (15.0 mg/mL) and m-F-PEACl (2.0 mg/mL) were added into the perovskite precursor solution. The precursor solution was spin-coated in a two-step process at 1000 rpm for 5 s and 5500 rpm for 30 s, respectively. 150 µL antisolvent was quickly dripped at the 15 s before the end of spin coating step. The film was immediately annealed at 110 °C for 15 min. PDADI (0.5 mg/mL) was spin-coated onto the perovskite film to act as an efficient passivation layer. Then, the surface treatment solution was subsequently spin-coated on the film at 5000 rpm for 30 s. The passivator volume of 70 µL was dropped at 6 s during spin-coating. Followed by annealing at 100 ℃ for 5 min. In details, SAM solution was spin-coated on the substrate at 3000 rpm for 30 s, and annealed at 100 °C for 10 min.
